headline: Steadier image quality on big boards
summary: Boards with hundreds of images hold their sharpness better while you zoom, and images scrolling into view load detail right away instead of waiting for you to stop.

improved.title: Sharp images stay sharp
improved.description: An image whose full detail is already loaded now always draws at that detail. Previously it could fall back to a low-resolution preview when the board was busy, even though the sharp version was ready to use.

improved.title: Steadier quality while zooming
improved.description: The renderer now keeps its quality decisions from one frame to the next, so images no longer swap back and forth between detail levels as the view moves under the cursor.

fixed.title: Images entering view during zoom
fixed.description: An image scrolling into view while you zoom now loads its real detail immediately instead of staying on a low-resolution preview until the zoom stops.
